recipe.text: Fresh concept vs prior ring-survival RoundLoop: a lane-siege/breach-defense loop. CONFIG table defines core center, 4 lane gates, gateDistance, intermission, and a waves array (count/health/walkSpeed). Each wave spawns count enemies distributed across lanes marching to the core; a wave clears only when all its enemies are dead (real combat, no auto-kill hook - that symbol is gate-blocked). Clearing the last wave prints [LaneSiege] VICTORY. All lifecycle events print with the [LaneSiege] tag for VERIFY.
